skills.summary: Multi-source cited research report
skills.job: Split a question into sub-questions, search, read primary sources, cross-check and write a cited report.
gotchas: Citing search snippets never opened
Letting one source answer every sub-question
Hiding disagreement between sources

skills.summary: Rate how far a source can be trusted
skills.job: Judge one source for authorship, method, funding, recency and fit to the claim it supports.
gotchas: Trusting a domain name over authorship
Treating recency as quality
Judging the outlet when the claim cites another source

skills.summary: Trace a claim back to its origin
skills.job: Follow a claim or statistic through citations to the first place it was stated.
triggers: where does this claim come from
gotchas: Stopping at the first article that repeats it
Missing that a number changed along the chain
Treating a press release as the original study

skills.summary: Map competitors from public sources
skills.job: Build a structured view of competitors using only public pages, with dates and sources.
gotchas: Comparing a marketing page to a real feature
Missing indirect competitors
Quoting stale pricing

skills.summary: Find sound inputs for market size
skills.job: Find and rate the published figures needed for a top-down and bottom-up market size estimate.
gotchas: Copying a vendor report headline as fact
Mixing currencies and years
Multiplying unrelated percentages

skills.summary: Walk a paper's citations both ways
skills.job: Follow references backward and citing works forward from a seed paper to map the literature around it.
gotchas: Counting citations as agreement
Ignoring retractions and corrections
Stopping before the field's newer work

skills.summary: Find credible experts on a topic
skills.job: Identify people with real standing on a topic and show the evidence for each.
triggers: who should I talk to about
gotchas: Picking the loudest voice over the most qualified
Confusing a title with expertise in the subtopic
Listing contact details scraped from private pages

skills.summary: Build a sourced timeline of events
skills.job: Order events from several sources into a dated timeline and flag conflicts.
gotchas: Mixing time zones and date formats
Treating report date as event date
Smoothing over sources that disagree

skills.summary: Compare what sources say on one point
skills.job: Line up several sources on a single question and show where they agree, differ and why.
gotchas: Calling a difference in wording a disagreement
Ignoring that sources use different definitions
Counting sources that copy each other as independent

skills.summary: Locate the primary source for a topic
skills.job: Find the original document, dataset, filing or study behind secondary coverage.
gotchas: Accepting a summary page as the primary
Missing a newer version of the document
Reading a preprint as final

skills.summary: Spot framing and slant in a text
skills.job: Read a text for slant, loaded wording, omissions and incentives, and report evidence for each.
gotchas: Calling disagreement bias
Judging only word choice and not omissions
Assuming the other side is neutral

skills.summary: Summarize a research paper accurately
skills.job: Summarize a paper's question, method, result and limits, reading beyond the abstract.
gotchas: Relaying the abstract's claims untested
Dropping sample size and limits
Reporting correlation as cause

skills.summary: Design a systematic search strategy
skills.job: Turn a research question into search terms, sources, filters and inclusion rules, then log what was run.
gotchas: One keyword set for every database
No record of queries run
Inclusion rules written after seeing results

skills.summary: Research products before a buying choice
skills.job: Compare products on criteria the user sets, using specs from maker pages and independent reviews.
gotchas: Using affiliate roundups as independent tests
Comparing spec numbers measured differently
Quoting prices that change daily

skills.summary: Verify a quote and its attribution
skills.job: Check whether a quote is real, who said it, in what context and in what exact words.
gotchas: Accepting quote sites as sources
Verifying the words but not the context
Missing a translation that changed the wording

skills.summary: Find public datasets for a question
skills.job: Locate public datasets that fit a question and check licence, coverage, format and freshness.
triggers: where can I get data on
gotchas: Ignoring the licence
Missing that coverage stops at an old year
Picking an aggregate when row-level data exists

skills.summary: Scan a topic for real trends
skills.job: Separate lasting trends from hype in a topic using dated signals from several kinds of source.
gotchas: Counting repeated press coverage as growth
No dates on any signal
Reading search interest as adoption

skills.summary: Research a person or company before a meeting
skills.job: Build a briefing on a person or organisation from public sources before an interview or meeting.
triggers: research this company before my interview
gotchas: Confusing people with the same name
Using private or scraped personal data
Reporting rumour from forums as fact

skills.summary: One-page fact sheet with sources
skills.job: Condense verified facts on a topic into a one-page sheet, each fact with source and date.
gotchas: Facts without dates
Mixing verified and estimated numbers
Padding with filler to fill the page

skills.summary: Check whether a statistic holds up
skills.job: Test a quoted statistic for denominator, sample, time frame and whether it supports the claim.
gotchas: Ignoring the denominator
Comparing percent change with percentage points
Taking a survey sample as the population
